note: Cenotes found on the cave maps, kept aside for a direct database import (see cenote_candidates.py). Positions come from maps: never mark them as GPS.

entries.name: Chikin Ha
maps: Sistema Chikin Ha (part) - cavern and cave entrance (Mafia Maps 2006)
Sistema Ponderosa and Sistema X'tabay - line plot (AMCS Activities Newsletter 2001)
entries.why: the database position (Google Maps) is 83 m north-west of the cenote's pool, in the forest; this is the pool on the satellite image and OSM's 'Cenote Chikin-Ha' (the Ponderosa map gives the same spot)

entries.name: Koi
maps: Sistema K'oox Baal - Czech Speleological Society 2013
Nai Tucha (Tux Kupaxa), Sistema Tux Kupaxa - Czech survey 2009
entries.why: the database's position is 636 m from this map's (near Nai Tucha): doubtful

entries.name: Rainbow
maps: Sistema Ponderosa and Sistema X'tabay - line plot (AMCS Activities Newsletter 2001)
entries.why: the database position is Ponderosa's (Eden's), 14 m from it; the map puts Rainbow 600 m further north

entries.name: Cristalino
maps: Sistema Ponderosa and Sistema X'tabay - line plot (AMCS Activities Newsletter 2001)
entries.why: the database position (Gerrard 2015) is 35 m west of the cenote's open water (satellite image, OSM 'Cenote Cristalino')
